name: Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt
description: Step inside the masterpieces of two iconic artists in this immersive light and sound show. A mesmerizing experience that brings classic paintings to life on a grand scale.
longDescription:
"Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt" is an art exhibition at the Alfândega Congress Center, presenting the works of Claude Monet and Gustav Klimt through a large-scale, immersive digital projection. This event transforms the traditional viewing of art by projecting famous paintings onto expansive surfaces, accompanied by a synchronized audio track. The format aims to provide a dynamic engagement with the artists' oeuvres, moving beyond static displays to a multi-sensory presentation of their styles and periods.

Visitors will encounter a continuous loop of projected imagery, allowing for a self-paced exploration of the visual content. The experience is designed to be accessible to a broad audience, offering a different perspective on well-known artworks. The Alfândega Congress Center, a historic building on the Douro riverfront, provides a grand setting for the projections, with its large halls accommodating the scale of the digital display. The duration of a full cycle of projections is typically around 60 minutes.

Tickets for "Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt" are priced variably and can be purchased in advance. The Alfândega Congress Center is located near the river and is accessible via public transport, with bus stops nearby. It is also within walking distance from the historic Ribeira district. The venue is generally accessible, though specific details regarding mobility access should be confirmed directly with the venue. The event is suitable for families.
